checks.label: Complete fixture loads into both browser records
clear delivers a real trusted localStorage event with a null key
Loss handling performs no automatic save
First recovery entry moves focus to its visible explanation
Game transaction controls are replaced by the recovery surface
Space cannot write a new game step during protection
The downloaded memory envelope is exactly the complete original
Opening the restore confirmation does not write
Confirmed restore writes the exact full memory envelope to both records
The next native game action commits the exact engine result after restoration

scope: Fresh isolated contexts with complete constructed valid saves; native storage.clear/removeItem/setItem, native sessionStorage iframe events, actual downloads and existing Web Locks.
limitations: Logical browser viewports, not physical devices or external screen readers.
Explicit storage-write fault injection remains in node tests; this driver does not override browser quota.
No claim that localStorage offers atomic compare-and-set when Web Locks are unavailable or noncooperating writers bypass the lock.
